passages.text:
The palace burns behind you.

Your half-brother has seized the throne, declaring you a traitor before the court can even protest.

You carry only the last royal banner and a few loyal survivors.

If you die here, the kingdom dies with you.

choices.label: Search the ruined storehouse for supplies
Flee immediately before the patrols return

passages.text:
You force open a collapsed door and find a small cache of food and bandages.

It isn’t much, but it’s enough to keep your people moving.

Every scrap matters now.

You resist the urge to search.

A delay could be fatal.

You lead your survivors into the night with empty hands and a heavy banner.

Two roads stretch into darkness.

One is slower and safer. The other is fast—but watched.

The forest swallows your footsteps.

You move quietly, avoiding torchlight and steel.

Your people are exhausted, but alive.

The coastal road is faster, but open.

A distant patrol passes close enough for you to hear their armor.

You hold your breath until the night swallows them.

Near a burned village, survivors emerge from the ruins.

They recognize the banner.

"My lord… please. We have nowhere left to go."

Your supplies are thin. Your future is thinner.

choices.label: Share what you can and take them with you
Refuse. You cannot risk the banner for strangers

passages.text:
You split your supplies and offer protection.

The survivors join your group, shaken but grateful.

Word travels fast in desperate lands.

Tonight, your banner becomes a promise.

You turn them away.

Your followers say nothing, but the silence feels heavier than steel.

The banner survives the night—but your name begins to harden into rumor.

Tonight, your banner becomes a warning.

Dawn breaks over the frontier.

A stretch of wild land lies ahead—untamed, quiet, and far from your half-brother’s reach.

This could be a refuge.

Or the first stone of a kingdom reborn.

Your people look to you for direction.

The banner is more than cloth now.

It is a vow.

Whatever kind of king you become… starts here.

ACT 1 COMPLETE

You survived the fall.

Your half-brother still rules the old throne.

But here, on the frontier, the last banner rises again.

The war will come.

The question is what kind of king will face it.
